# LAPRITEL

> LAPRITEL is a Ghana-based maker of hand-beaded handbags. Each bag is fully beaded by skilled artisans and made to order, with ready-to-ship colours where stock is available.

## Shop

- [Collections](https://lapritel.vercel.app/collections): every LAPRITEL bag collection
- [Shop](https://lapritel.vercel.app/shop): browse bags and colours
- [Featured](https://lapritel.vercel.app/featured): customers wearing LAPRITEL
